items.stem: Which of the following shapes can be used to measure area without leaving gaps or overlaps?

Which of the following rectangles would have the same area but a different perimeter?

In a game, the first player rolls a die and picks up tiles equal to the number on the die. The second player then takes a turn and adds tiles to the same shape. If the first player picks up 4 tiles and the second player picks up 6 tiles, and the perimeter of the shape becomes 24, what is the initial perimeter before the second player added tiles?
What is the breadth of a rectangular garden with an area of 64 square m and a length of 16 m?
What is the area of a rectangular field if its length is 32 cm and breadth is 6 cm?
